# Informix.Database

```m
Informix.Database(server as text, database as text, optional options as nullable record) as table
```

Returns a table of SQL tables and views available in an Informix database.

*Description: Microsoft, MIT ([THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md](../../../../THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md)).*

Reference: [Microsoft Learn](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/powerquery-m/informix-database)

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Optional |
|---|---|---|
| `server` | `text` | no |
| `database` | `text` | no |
| `options` | `nullable record` | yes |
